title: Janus_Tachyon_Star_T1_Lookback_Result

t1_result.unresolved_reason: B had no measured point-source candidate but failed the frozen local SNR8 sensitivity requirement; injected SNR8 was not recovered while SNR12 was recovered.

admitted_interpretation: The learned TACHYON-STAR-001 A-B-C motif did not replicate in any of the eight fully adjudicable primary T1 trials.
The ninth sealed trial is unresolved rather than negative because the frozen SNR8 sensitivity gate failed at B.
T1 therefore provides a negative/incomplete replication result, not a positive replication and not a complete nine-trial null.
The six paired independent-LUCI B witnesses stayed blind because their preregistered trigger condition, a primary B candidate, never occurred.

effect_on_tachyon_star_hypothesis.policy: Do not erase the hypothesis or the original observation; reduce confidence in the specific learned timing motif and move replication to independent cadence-rich corpora.
